articles.title: Fed's Goolsbee affirms that the Fed will have to make decisions with available data

articles.author: Joshua Gibson
articles.summary: The Canadian Dollar (CAD) found a fresh wave of weakness on Thursday, tipping into a fresh five-month low against the US Dollar (USD) as Loonie traders find few reasons to bid up the battered CAD. US jobs data would typically take the pride of place as this week’s dominant data release on Friday.
articles.title: Canadian Dollar finds fresh losses on Thursday

articles.author: Christian Borjon Valencia
articles.summary: EUR/USD remains steady during the North American session on Thursday, yet registering back-to-back bearish days as the US Dollar strengthens amid the ongoing government shutdown and the absence of US economic data releases like Initial Jobless Claims. The pair trades at 1.1719, down 0.09%.
articles.title: EUR/USD steady as investors flock to Dollar during US shutdown

articles.author: Christian Borjon Valencia
articles.summary: The NZD/USD reversed its course on Thursday as it formed a doji after hitting weekly highs near the 200-day Simple Moving Average (SMA) of 0.5845, but it reversed, ending the day virtually unchanged at around 0.5816.
articles.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Stalls near 200-SMA, bearish bias emerges
